$comment: What a page must show for its search intent (IN1 to IN5) and to be trusted (TR1 to TR8). Rules: rules/search-intent.md and rules/eeat-and-people-first.md. Schema: schemas/profiles.ts. Every rule starts as a warning (decision 40); set a rule to "fail" once the pages are measured. Revised 2026-10-09: richer needs per intent (the elements a reader expects before they stop searching), and the provenance, experience and pressure checks.

needs.label: a direct answer under the H1
why it matters to the reader (a 'why' or 'what it means' heading)
a real example, a mistake to avoid, or a step the reader can repeat
a source the reader can check (an outside link or a sources section)
a link to a next step

avoidFirstScreen.label: a link to pricing or checkout (a sales push before the answer)

needs.label: a quick answer under the H1
a backup or safety step before the fix

any.text: (take a backup|back up your site|make a backup)

needs.label: numbered or named fix steps
a check that the fix worked

any.text: (check that|to confirm|you should (now )?see|if it worked|to test)

needs.label: the versions and the date the steps were tested
when to ask for help, with a link
a one-sentence verdict
the criteria used to compare
a comparison table
where the other option is stronger (honest, both sides)
the date the facts were checked
who should choose which option
a visible price or a link to the pricing page
a risk reducer (refund, cancellation or a move that is handled for the buyer)
who it is for, by situation (a router or a 'who it is for' section)

any.heading: (who (this|it) is for|right for you|best for|is this for)

needs.label: what is included, in words (a feature list, a plan card or an answer block)
what happens after the action (the next step, who replies, how)

any.text: (what happens next|after you (choose|order|sign up|pay)|we (reply|email|contact) you|you (get|receive) an email|next steps?)

needs.label: how to reach a person before and after buying
the last doubts answered (a FAQ)
one clear primary action
one sentence that says what the business is, in the first screen
a direct link to the place the reader wants
the main destinations by the reader's situation (a router, or links to the main services)
how to reach a person
what the business does not do (so a reader with the wrong need leaves quickly)
the decision criteria
who each option suits
a recommendation with its reason
a link to a next step

any.text: (not (for|the right|a good fit)|isn.t (for|the right|a good fit)|(does not|doesn.t) (include|cover|offer)|only (covers|for)|one website per)

patterns: \b(hurry|act now|last chance|limited[- ]time|ends (today|tonight|soon)|only \d+ (left|spots?|seats?)|no questions asked|don.t miss (out|this)|selling fast|while stocks last|\d+ people are (viewing|looking))\b

owed.label: A support email, or a form route, so the free-move form can send
A measured number with its source (uptime, speed, first reply, year founded)
Real reviews with the reviewer's name, role and permission
One approved case study with real numbers
Confirmation of what business hosting and managed VPS include
The editorial policy page, reviewed and published, so provenance can link to it
